title: Onboard
description: data of: onboard.py --json (ty onboard --json). How far this rig is from a first night, each step with how it is known, and the next step. With --confirm STEP: the step kept and what it means.

how_known.description: checked now, measured, kept on disk, proven by use, set by the person, the person's word, or not yet

now.description: true for a check of what works now (doctor.py); false for what was done once, or set

kit.description: What the skills choose their steps by.

motor_focuser.description: true: the project's motor focuser; false: a focuser by hand; null: not known (both by the person's word)

source.description: example: the camera is still the example settings', not the person's

keeper.description: keeper.py can hold this camera cold (cooled, Altair's library, a tec_target)

checked.description: false with --no-check: the steps doctor.py checks now were left out
